title: Horizontal Wind Model 07
text: Implement Horizontal Wind Model 07, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Model} sets Horizontal wind model type; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: μ l h
ports.summary: Geodetic latitude, longitude, and geopotential altitude three-element vector | altitude is a value between 0 and 500 km

ports.name: Ap
ports.summary: Ap index scalar | range from 0 to 400

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Model
params.values: Horizontal wind model type Quiet (default) | Total | Disturbance

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior Error (default) | Warning | None
